name: Equipment hire
summary: A single bonded rental, settled in the studio's own token — no card processor, no float.
description: A renter books a piece of equipment — a camera kit, an audio rig, a tool — directly from its owner. Both sides lock a stake worth more than the deal, so returning it and paying for it are each party's most profitable move — no card network, no security deposit held by a platform. The composition pins one ERC-20 as the whole assembly's settlement currency, set once by the studio that designed it: checkout writes that pin straight into the deal, so no token picker ever appears and every signer sees the same denomination the assembly was built in.
